BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 60
DECLARING THAT THE NATIONAL ANTHEM OF THE PHILIPPINES SHALL BE SUNG ONLY TO ITS FILIPINO LYRICS
WHEREAS, the development and propagation of the National Language of the Philippines is one of the dreams of the heroes of our race, apart from being provided for in the Constitution of our Republic;
WHEREAS, certain events occurring in our archipelago, and especially in other countries, concerning the singing of our National Anthem in a foreign language are quite conspicuous and are no longer in accord with the spirit of our nationalism; and
WHEREAS, the Filipino Language is now one of our official languages;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, DIOSDADO MACAPAGAL, President of the Republic of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law and in pursuance of the objectives of the Constitution and of Commonwealth Act No. 570, do hereby declare and order that the National Anthem of the Philippines shall be sung only to its Filipino lyrics on every occasion, whether here or in other countries.
Done in the City of Manila, this nineteenth day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and sixty-three.
(Signed) DIOSDADO MACAPAGAL
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(Signed) RUFINO G. HECHANOVA
Executive Secretary
[Translated from the original Filipino text.]
